title: Clean up Core remote branches and superseded tags (CEO direction 2026-11-15), from a host that may delete them
goal: CEO direction 2026-11-15 to a cloud session: 'clean up remote branches and tags', then, asked what to remove: delete the 9 wip/* branches now without saving them, and remove the stray tags and the superseded susi-distill and susi-snapshot candidate tags; release tags vX.Y.Z stay. The cloud session's Git proxy refused the first branch deletion with HTTP 403 (as it refuses every tag push), so nothing was deleted. Carry it out from a host that may delete remote refs. Both the branch deletions and the tag deletions are refused by pre-push push-policy by design (unpreserved branch, tag immutability), so they need --no-verify; that is the CEO's explicit direction for exactly the refs listed here and nothing else.

cleanup.branches_note: None of the 9 is merged into main and no other ref holds their tips; after deletion their commits are gone from the remote. The CEO chose this knowingly. The tips above are the only record.
cleanup.candidate_tags_note: 100 susi-distill/susi-snapshot tags, all for versions that have a release tag or for 0.21.68. 62 of them point at composed or legacy-preserved commits that no branch or release tag contains; deleting them removes those commits from the remote. Core's storage guard (local-snapshot guard) will report every deleted tag as a finding; that is expected here.
cleanup.done_when: git ls-remote origin shows refs/heads/main as the only branch and only vX.Y.Z tags; then close this task.
keep: every refs/tags/vX.Y.Z release tag (70 on the remote, plus v0.21.68 once T-CLAUDECLOUDREL-6 publishes it)
refs/candidates/*, refs/agents/*, refs/preserve/* and the task-queue refs: not part of this direction

limitations: Nothing was deleted by the cloud session: its Git proxy refused the deletion (HTTP 403).
The Susi Board could not be told: the same proxy refuses board posts.

Carried out later from a Windows host (see results). refs/tags/target-seed was deleted last: the local session first kept it on a stale source comment naming scripts/cloud-target-seed.sh, found that script was retired on 2026-11-09 (docs/workflow-speed.md), and deleted the tag once the CEO confirmed.
The branch deletions did not need --no-verify: push-policy admits the deletion of a non-agent wip/* branch. Only the tag deletions bypassed pre-push.
The 100 deleted candidate tags were not removed from local clones that had already fetched them; such a clone could publish one again with a tag push.
The storage guard reports each deleted tag as a DELETED finding and retains it under refs/susi-guard/origin/tags/*; that is expected after this direction.

results.branches_deleted: all 9 listed wip/* branches, in one atomic push leased to the listed tips, through pre-push
results.candidate_tags_deleted: all 100 listed susi-distill and susi-snapshot tags, each deletion leased to the tag's inventoried object, with pre-push bypassed (--no-verify) as directed
results.ceo_confirmation: Confirmed again by the CEO in a local Claude session on 2026-11-15: the 9 wip/* branches without saving them, the stray tag dev, then the listed candidate tags, then target-seed.
results.remote_after: git ls-remote origin: refs/heads/main is the only branch; 71 tags, all vX.Y.Z
stray_tags_deleted: dev (with its GitHub pre-release and assets, through GitHub's release removal)
target-seed (with its GitHub pre-release and assets, through GitHub's release removal)
